title: Paul McCartney live: O2 Arena, London | 2024
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the O2 Arena in London, England, on 19 December 2024.

It was the final Got Back show of 2024, and the second of two consecutive nights at the O2.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

They were joined during ‘Get Back’ by The Rolling Stones’ guitarist Ronnie Wood. McCartney played his restored 1961 Höfner 500/1 bass guitar, which was stolen in 1972 but was found and returned in early 2024.

In the encore, McCartney was joined by his former Beatles bandmate Ringo Starr, who played drums on ‘Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band (Reprise)’ and ‘Helter Skelter’.

HUGE Night for Beatles fans at Paul McCartney concert at the O2, London this evening….. pic.twitter.com/Fs31BPfKmm

— Raph Pour-Hashemi ? (@RaphPH) December 20, 2024

McCartney previously performed at the O2 Arena on 22 December 2009 for the Good Evening Europe Tour; 5 December 2011 for the On The Run Tour; 23 and 24 May 2015 for the Out There Tour; and 16 December 2018 for the Freshen Up Tour.
